title: Dr Frost Arctic Cherry Cola Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Shortfill Cherry Cola Ice blends the sweet, juicy flavour of Cherry with the tangy sparkle of Cola, perfectly balanced by a crisp menthol exhale. This unique and refreshing combination delivers bold flavour and frosty refreshment, making it an excellent choice for vapers seeking a distinctive e-liquid profile. Part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour, offering the same intense taste profiles as disposable vapes. Unlike traditional high-VG shortfills, Arctic Shortfills have a 50VG/50PG ratio, making them ideal for low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits. The 100ml bottle includes space for two 10ml nicotine shots, giving users the flexibility to customise their nicotine strength or enjoy it nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical option for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold flavours and exceptional value.
